name: SenseVoice-API
description: OpenAI-compatible Speech-to-Text API powered by SenseVoice-Small (Alibaba FunAudioLLM). Features: emotion detection (happy/sad/angry/neutral), audio event detection (Speech/Music/Applause/Laughter), auto language identification (zh/en/ja/ko/yue), word-level timestamps, WebSocket streaming. Ultra-low latency (~70ms for 10s audio on GPU). Supports both GPU and CPU mode (set DEVICE to cpu for CPU-only, no GPU required). REST API at /v1/audio/transcriptions. For GPU mode: remove --gpus all from Extra Parameters if running CPU-only.

paths.name: Model Cache
paths.description: Model download cache (~900MB). First start downloads model here; subsequent starts are instant. Persists across container recreates.

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: REST API and WebSocket port. Swagger docs at /docs

variables.name: Device
variables.description: Inference device. GPU: cuda:0 (recommended, ~70ms/10s audio), cuda:1 for second GPU. CPU: set to cpu (slower, but no GPU required — remove --gpus all from Extra Parameters).

variables.name: Model ID
variables.description: HuggingFace model identifier. Default model is pre-downloaded in image.

variables.name: HuggingFace Endpoint
variables.description: HuggingFace download endpoint. China users: change to https://hf-mirror.com for faster model downloads.

variables.name: Enable Speaker Diarization
variables.description: Identify who is speaking using cam++ model. Adds ~7MB speaker model download on first start. Results appear in verbose_json format as 'segments' with 'speaker' field. Requires response_format=verbose_json in client.
